title: Herbie Hancock – Round Midnight - Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (CD, 1986)
descriptionText: The Herbie Hancock – Round Midnight - Original Motion Picture Soundtrack CD, released in 1986 by CBS, features the legendary jazz artist's compositions inspired by the film. Produced by Hancock himself, the album blends elements of bop and film score/soundtrack styles, making it a unique addition to any jazz lover's collection. With its origins in the United States, this CD showcases Hancock's talent as both a musician and a filmmaker, making it a must-have for fans of his work.
